      • role

        @NameInMap(value="Role")
public String role

        The node type. Valid values:

        • Master: Primary node.
        • Slave: Secondary node.

        For Cluster Edition instances, this parameter is not required. You can specify the node by using the NodeId parameter.

        example:

        Master
